label: Introduction
subgoals: Meet sine and cosine as circle coordinates
Set radius 1 so legs equal sin and cos

visual.title: The cosine starts at its peak
visual.caption: Cosine is the x-coordinate on the unit circle. At angle 0 the point is (1, 0), so the cosine wave starts at 1, falls to 0 at a quarter turn and reaches −1 at a half turn.

predict.question: For y = cos x, what is y at x = 0?
predict.explain: At angle 0 the unit-circle point is (1, 0), so the x-coordinate and cos 0 are 1.
